scope: Repository submission-readiness audit of the plugin package, bundled skill, MCP catalog safety metadata, OAuth discovery, response boundaries, and configured side effects. Not an authenticated production or OpenAI portal review.

fixed.finding: Listing subtitle exceeded 30 characters; support URL and packaged icons were missing.
fixed.resolution: 26-character subtitle, publisher contact URL, 384px square PNG referenced as logo and composerIcon, expanded description, and a starter prompt independent of private demo card keys.

fixed.finding: Skill discovery included generic boards, notes and project-status requests.
fixed.resolution: Require an explicit Kanera request or established Kanera context; preserve user-selected workflows and treat project content as untrusted data.

fixed.finding: Read-only multi-step reporting could start agent runs and publish outcome comments.
fixed.resolution: Run tracking is limited to authorised implementation work; outcome comments require task authorisation.

fixed.finding: Comment publication and automation creation were labelled additive-only.
fixed.resolution: Both advertise destructiveHint=true because notifications/publication or future workflow sends cannot be retracted. Creation idempotentHint remains false; optional replay keys are retained.

fixed.finding: Automation tools advertised no open-world effects despite configurable outbound webhook actions.
fixed.resolution: Create, update and enable/disable automation tools advertise openWorldHint=true and disclose future comment/webhook effects. Read/delete tools remain bounded to the workspace catalog.

fixed.finding: Creation descriptions discouraged retries even with an optional replay key.
fixed.resolution: Clarify unkeyed retry risk and keep shared replay/fanout guidance in server instructions, preserving the existing catalog size budget.

reviewed.result: Public MCP response header reports 4.0.0, matching local plugin and MCP manifests. Protected-resource metadata and OAuth issuer discovery were reachable in this session.
Retain the supported .codex-plugin/plugin.json and .app.json layout and existing registered app mapping; no lifecycle hooks or bundled secrets.

OAuth authorization-code PKCE, resource-bound tokens, rotation/revocation, and per-resource permission enforcement already exist. Interactive grants intentionally request read/write; live user roles and host approvals constrain writes. Not retested with a production reviewer login.

Session output is credential scope and identity context rather than authentication material; domain errors are bounded; telemetry logs exclude arguments/results; configuration collections are bounded. Entity IDs, attribution and activity dates serve navigation/reporting. Existing privacy policy discloses MCP sharing and retention; confirm actual reviewer-account responses before attesting.
Automation actions reference preconfigured workspace endpoint IDs, not raw arbitrary URLs or secrets. Comments can enqueue notifications; API mutations reuse activity/outbox side effects.

validation.manifestAndAssets: passed field limits, HTTPS URLs, PNG dimensions/size, and canonical/bundled skill equality
validation.e2e: Passed final-source MCP matrix over HTTP and stdio in modern and legacy protocol eras.
validation.preFixEvidence: e2e/artifacts/20261008T110708Z-4023179 demonstrates the new disclosure assertion failing before automations.set_enabled explicitly named webhook endpoints.

isolatedTestPolicy: Updated existing contract expectations only; no isolated tests removed or added. New wire-level annotation coverage is in the existing MCP E2E matrix, with the mapping in e2e/COVERAGE.md.
remaining: Deploy the changed MCP safety annotations/instructions and rescan the hosted server in the submission portal.
Verify publisher identity and portal permissions; confirm .app.json maps to the intended submission connection and complete the domain challenge.
Provision dedicated synthetic reviewer data/account and run exactly five positive and three negative cases in ChatGPT, including access denial and ambiguous targets.
Add accessible walkthrough recording, review cases and release notes; enter credentials privately in the dashboard.
Resolve automated portal findings and perform desktop/mobile ChatGPT validation before policy attestations.

package.status: Draft package; portal setup and review materials remain outstanding.
package.documentationAssumption: Documentation and bundled skill describe the plugin as available, as requested by the user; publication is still a portal action.
